done_when: A thread follow-up starts a turn only when the new batch has a message from an allowed sender, proven by a test where only the root sender is allowed and another person's follow-up gets no reply

findings.body: The only added proof is a unit test that calls createGroupProcessor directly, mocks sender authorization (this file, lines 110–118 and 820–822), substitutes in-memory input/storage (lines 290–339), and asserts that mocked spawnAgent was not called. It meaningfully exercises the new gate, but does not satisfy the explicit requirement for runtime Done-when items to have end-to-end proof through the real entry point. Add a suite-run test using the running runtime and real database: configure only the root sender as allowed, establish their triggered thread, submit another person's follow-up through inbound delivery, and verify that no turn or reply results. Fake only third-party service edges.
